widgets.text: Health is the row of yellow marks at the top right; potions refill it.

rows: Press against a wall to take cover

widgets.text: Duck into the background (Up) to dodge, then step out and shoot when the orc reloads. Shoot behind you without turning by shooting backward (shotgun).
Four worlds of Tuul: the Mines, the Forest, the Wastelands and Sarlac's Castle, each several levels; passwords save progress.
Androthi prisoners give items and hints; don't shoot them.
Defeat Sarlac at the end of the castle.
